items.title: Clarity Act’s failure gave crypto ‘faster’ regulatory wins, Bitwise CIO says
items.summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan says Clarity’s defeat left crypto with fewer restrictions and faster SEC action.

items.title: Dogecoin Is Getting Apps as DogeOS Opens Its Public Testnet
items.summary: The team behind the MyDoge wallet opened a public test of DogeOS, a layer that lets developers build lending platforms and games on top of the meme coin network.

items.title: OFAC Sanctions Tren de Aragua ATM Network, Lists Seven Tron Addresses
items.summary: Chainalysis says the wallets’ counterparties had exposure to laundering networks used by Mexican and Colombian cartels and Venezuelan launderers.

items.title: Standard Chartered sees Ethena’s USDe reaching $40B, ENA hitting $2
items.summary: The bank also expects Ethena’s ENA token to rise roughly sevenfold to $2 by the end of 2028 as USDe scales and token buybacks increase.
